name: TablesOfContents
description: A collection of TableOfContents objects that represent the tables of contents in a document.
remarks: Use the TablesOfContents property to return the TablesOfContents collection. The following example inserts a table of contents entry that references the selected text in the active document. Use the Add method to add a table of contents to a document. The following example adds a table of contents at the beginning of the active document. The example builds the table of contents from all paragraphs styled as either Heading 1, Heading 2, or Heading 3. Use TablesOfContents (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single TableOfContents object. The index number represents the position of the table of contents in the document. The following example updates the page numbers of the items in the first table of figures in the active document.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TablesOfContents object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of tables of contents in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns or sets the formatting for the tables of contents in the specified document. Read/write WdTocFormat.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual TableOfContents object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: MarkEntry
methods.signature: MarkEntry(Range As Range, [Entry As Variant], [EntryAutoText As Variant], [TableID As Variant], [Level As Variant]) As Field
methods.description: Inserts a TC (Table of Contents Entry) field after the specified range. The method returns a Field object representing the TC field.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location of the entry. The TC field is inserted after Range.

parameters.name: Entry
parameters.description: The text that appears in the table of contents or table of figures. To indicate a subentry, include the main entry text and the subentry text, separated by a colon (:) (for example, "Introduction:The Product").

parameters.name: EntryAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry name that includes text for the index, table of figures, or table of contents (Entry is ignored).

parameters.name: TableID
parameters.description: A one-letter identifier for the table of figures or table of contents item (for example, "i" for an "illustration").

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: A level for the entry in the table of contents or table of figures.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, [UseHeadingStyles As Variant], [UpperHeadingLevel As Variant], [LowerHeadingLevel As Variant], [UseFields As Variant], [TableID As Variant], [RightAlignPageNumbers As Variant], [IncludePageNumbers As Variant], [AddedStyles As Variant], [UseHyperlinks As Variant], [HidePageNumbersInWeb As Variant], [UseOutlineLevels As Variant]) As TableOfContents
methods.description: Returns a TableOfContents object that represents a table of contents added to a document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where you want the table of contents to appear. The table of contents replaces the range, if the range isn't collapsed.

parameters.name: UseHeadingStyles
parameters.description: True to use built-in heading styles to create the table of contents. The default value is True.

parameters.name: UpperHeadingLevel
parameters.description: The starting heading level for the table of contents. Corresponds to the starting value used with the \o switch for a Table of Contents (TOC) field. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: LowerHeadingLevel
parameters.description: The ending heading level for the table of contents. Corresponds to the ending value used with the \o switch for a Table of Contents (TOC) field. The default value is 9.

parameters.name: UseFields
parameters.description: True if Table of Contents Entry (TC) fields are used to create the table of contents. Use the MarkEntry method to mark entries to be included in the table of contents. The default value is False.

parameters.name: TableID
parameters.description: A one-letter identifier that's used to build a table of contents from TC fields. Corresponds to the \f switch for a Table of Contents (TOC) field. For example, "T" builds a table of contents from TC fields using the table identifier T. If this argument is omitted, TC fields aren't used.

parameters.name: RightAlignPageNumbers
parameters.description: True if page numbers in the table of contents are aligned with the right margin. The default value is True.

parameters.name: IncludePageNumbers
parameters.description: True to include page numbers in the table of contents. The default value is True.

parameters.name: AddedStyles
parameters.description: The string name for additional styles used to compile the table of contents (styles other than the Heading 1 – Heading 9 styles). Use the Add method of a HeadingStyles object to create new heading styles.

parameters.name: UseHyperlinks
parameters.description: True if entries in a table of contents should be formatted as hyperlinks when the document is being publishing to the web. The default value is True.

parameters.name: HidePageNumbersInWeb
parameters.description: True if page numbers in a table of contents should be hidden when the document is being publishing to the web. The default value is True.

parameters.name: UseOutlineLevels
parameters.description: True to use outline levels to create the table of contents. The default is False.
